tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i bstan bcos bzhugs so//

༄༅// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// thos dang bsam la rab brten nas// bsgom pa'i tshul la sbyor ba'i phyir// bdag nyid dben par 'dug pa na// tshul 'di snang ba brjod par bya// khams gsum sems can thams cad ni// bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka dang*// rgyu med las ni byung bar rtogs// byed po phywa dang dbang phyug dang*// tshangs dang khyab 'jug phyi rol rdul// phag na mo yi rdzas bden pas// bdag dang 'jig rten bskyed ces smra// thams cad mkhyen pa nyag gcig ni// khams gsum 'di dag sems tsam ste// bdag las ma yin gzhan las min// gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min// chos rnams rten cing 'brel 'byung ste// de nyid rang gi ngo bos stong*// gcig dang tha dad rnam bral ba// rdzun dang bden pa rnam spangs shing*// sgyu ma chu zla la sogs ltar// mkhyen nas sems can rnams la gsungs// de ltar 'khrul dang ma 'khrul pa'i// rtsa ba gang nas byung yin zhes// me long las ni rang gzugs dang*// du ba las ni me bzhin du// rten cing 'brel 'byung chos bstan nas// rtog pa 'dir ni gsal brjod bya// sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa ni// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la// blang dor byas pas nyon mongs bskyed// yul 'di dag ni gang yin zhes// shes rab ldan pas legs brtags na// rnam rig shes pa las gzhan pa'i// rdul sogs phyi rol grub pa med// gang tshe yul gyi rdzas 'di dag /shes las gzhan na bdag gcig min// bstan med thogs pa med pa yi// rig las bem po'i rdzas mi skye// de phyir de byung 'brel pa med// de 'dod shes las yul rnams ni// snang bar mi rig 'brel med phyir// de phyir ci ltar snang ba 'di// shes las gzhan pa'i yul med de// de byung rang rig nyams myong bzhin// cha med rdul dang phya le ba// snang ba sems te de yi don// phyi rol gzhan du grub med phyir// tshangs sogs byed po min par rtogs// yid dang chos kyi 'brel pa yang*// rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin// de nyid de la dmigs pa la// zhen par zad kyi dngos bden med// de ltar tshogs drug shes pa 'di// don dang sems can snang ba dang*// bdag 'dzin dang ni rnam rig dang*// snang ba'i rnam pa gang byung ba// 'di ci gzhan gyis byas min na// bdag gis byed pa 'gyur ma yin// gnyis kyis ma bskyed gnyis med min// de phyir rgyal bas gsungs pa ltar// 'khor 'das thams cad sems tsam ste// 'di yi rgyu rkyen rten 'brel ni// tshogs drug yid dang kun gzhi zhes// gsungs te tshogs drug shes pa ni// dmigs rkyen la ltos de dag kyang*// gzugs sogs yul ni drug po yin// bdag rkyen dbang po drug po ste// de yang gzugs can dwang pa'o// gnyi ga sems las byung ba yin// yul dang dbang por rab snang ba// thog med khams la brten pa yin// don mthong rnam par shes yin kyang*// khyad par sems byung 'du byed ni// yid kyi rnam shes la brten te// de ma thag dang nyon yid gnyis// drug po skye dang 'gag pa yi// rkyen phyir de ma thag pa yin// tshogs drug skad cig skye 'gag gi

/grangs bzhin de dang 'brel ba yin// rnal 'byor ldan pa'i yid dang ni// rgyal ba'i bka' las 'di shes 'gyur// 'di yi cha shas sems nyid la// ngar sems nga rgyal 'dzin pa dang*// nga la chags shing ma rig bcas// 'jig tshogs thams cad bskyed pa'i phyir// nyon mongs can gyi yid ces bya// drug po 'gag ma thag yid ni// rnam shes skye ba'i gnas yin te// nyon yid nyon mongs gnas su 'gyur// bskyed dang sgrib pa'i nus par ldan// de phyir yid de rnam pa gnyis// khyad par blo gros ldan rnams la// kun gzhi'i rnam par shes gsungs te// 'di ni rten dang gnas dang ni// len pa'i rnam par shes kyang gsungs// tshogs bdun gyis bskyed las rnams kun// ma 'dres lung du ma bstan par// bsags pas rnam par smin ces bya// char chu rgya mtsho ji bzhin no// thams cad bskyed par byed pas na// sa bon kun ldang kun gzhi ste// rgyu yi rkyen zhes brjod pa yi// tshogs bdun log na de ldog phyir// rkyen gyi rnam shes zhes kyang bya// phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid na// kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'di nyid ni// spang bya kun gyi rtsa ba ste// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// bcom par bya bar gsungs pa yin// gang tshe sgrib bcas kun gzhi log /de tshe me long ye shes te// ye shes kun snang nga yir med// yongs su ma chad rtag tu ldan// shes bya rtogs shing der phyogs min// ye shes kun gyi rgyu mtshan phyir// chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// nyon mongs can gyi yid de ni// dpa' bar 'gro bas rab bcom nas// mthong bsgom nyon mongs rab spangs nas// nyon mongs med cing srid zhi med// mnyam nyid ye shes zhes su brjod// de ma thag pa'i yid de ni// drug po 'dzin pas 'dzin pa ste// rnam par rtog byed rnam rtog yin// de na yang dag shes rab dang*// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// bcom pas bzod pa che thob tshe// don bcas 'dzin pa gnas gyur pas// zhing ni dag pa ston pa dang*// dus rnams kun tu ye shes dang*// las rnams kun tu thogs med pa'i// rnam rtog gnas yongs gyur pa ni// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te// de ltar ye shes gnyis po 'di// bsgom pa dag pas srid zhi la// mi gnas zhi dang byams pa dang*// thugs rjer ldan zhing 'khor rnams la// sna tshogs sku dang gsung ston mdzad// chos chen dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung*// ting 'dzin gzungs rnam kun gyi gter// longs spyod rdzogs sku zhes su brjod// sgo lnga yid kyi cha gcig ni// yang dag kun rtog las skyes pa// bden bzhi'i tshul gyi rnam pa can// shes bzod la sogs bcu drug gis// don mthong bden par rtogs pa las// dbang po lnga rnams gnas gyur ni// don kun 'jug dang thams cad kyi// yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la// dbang 'byor de nyid mthar phyin pas// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te// khams rnams kun tu sna tshogs pa'i// dpag med bsam yas sprul pa yis// sems can kun don bsgrub pa'o// 'di ni sprul pa'i sku chen po// sems yid rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i// sku gsum mdzad par bcas pa rnams// chos dbyings spros bral dkyil 'khor du// rdzogs pa 'khor 'das thog med kun// gcig dang tha dad bral ba ru// bzhugs pa ngo bo nyid skur bzhed// rgyal bas gzhung gzhan kha cig tu// 'di la chos kyi sku zhes bstan// de tshe me long ye shes sku// gzhan ni gzugs sku gnyis zhes brjod// ye shes lnga dang sku bzhi yi// rang bzhin mngon gyur sangs rgyas te// sems yid rnam par shes pa yi// dri mar ldan gang kun gzhi yin// dri med rgyal ba'i snying por brjod// ma dag kun rtog 'joms byed pa// dag pa'i kun rtog las skyes pa'i// 'phags pa'i shes rab dbang po ni// 'dzin pa lam gyi bden par gsungs// don dam tshul 'di ma rtogs pas// rmongs rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams// theg chen gru 'di ma rtogs pas// gang gis pha rol phyin par 'gyur// kun gyis 'di don rtogs par shog
/rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i bstan bcos/ phag lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig la rang byung rdo rjes bde chen steng gi ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/// /
